plan: Drive: from District of Stewart, about 103 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.78901, -129.94978, pull off on Hwy 37 (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: none. The spot is at the road.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-16, Region 6. Season: ducks Sept 1 to Sept 30, 8 a day, 24 in possession and more rows (federal Migratory Birds Regulations, 99%). 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-03, closures 2026-10-16.
R6L-duck-drive-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-16: about 107 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.02 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.why: Short pack out: 0.0 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
